identitySignals: Website for 'Medical Business Professional Services Group' (MBPSG) is located in Oakland, CA, matching the agenda location
Website describes workers' compensation case management, ergonomic and safety services, consistent with a district Risk Management Department services agreement
Name matches the agenda vendor, but no registry record (Secretary of State, SAM.gov) was found to confirm the 'Inc.' entity, and the site's footer is dated 2013 with a TLS certificate mismatch
research.notes: No registry confirmation found; the corporate entity 'Medical Business Professional Services Group, Inc.' was not verified with the CA Secretary of State. Needs human review before publication.

profile.summary: Medical Business Professional Services Group (MBPSG) is an Oakland, California company that describes itself as providing work-health services to employers. Its website lists workers' compensation case management, ergonomic evaluations and workplace safety training such as CPR, first aid and AED programs.
